name: tacocat-gallery-api
description: The Cloudflare Worker behind the pix.tacocat.com photo gallery

scripts.dev: env -u npm_config_workspace npm run --silent --prefix ../web build && wrangler dev --local-upstream localhost:8787
scripts.check: wrangler types --check && tsc -p . && tsc -p src && tsc -p test && tsc -p test/stack
scripts.deploy: env -u npm_config_workspace npm run --silent --prefix ../web build && wrangler deploy
scripts.probes: wrangler d1 execute tacocat-proto --remote --command "SELECT run_at, idle_hours, location, seq, path, probe_city, status, total_ms, tls_ms, first_byte_ms, worker_colo, worker_ms, d1_colo, d1_primary, d1_rtt_ms, error FROM probe_result ORDER BY run_at, location, seq"
